query:
SELECT c.id as companyId, c.name as companyName, p.id as processId, p.name as processName 
FROM companies c 
LEFT JOIN processes p ON c.id = p.companyId 
WHERE c.name LIKE '%Lalita%'
ORDER BY c.id, p.name
